title: Color Analysis Tool
description: A Python tool for analyzing colors in images, providing detailed information about color distributions, harmonies, and color space conversions (RGB, HEX, CMYK, OKLab, OKLCh). Features include deterministic perceptual palette extraction (k-means++ clustering in OKLab), OKLCh color harmony calculations (complementary, analogous, triadic, tetradic), ICC-based CMYK conversion (FOGRA39), WCAG 2.2 and APCA contrast reporting, single image and batch processing, dominant color detection, flexible output formats (plain text, JSON, and CSS/Design Tokens), design token export compatible with W3C Design Token format and Tailwind CSS v4, and support for multiple image formats (PNG, JPG, TIFF, WebP, PSD).

creators.name: Semoglou, Michail
creators.affiliation: College of Design and Innovation, Tongji University

notes: This software is designed for designers, artists, and developers working with color analysis and manipulation. It provides color analysis including palette weight analysis, color space conversions, and color harmony calculations.
